source: f62a924 (2.1.1): mcp.mjs tools/list over stdio, and decide.mjs flags

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Show the user a round of questions in the browser. Pass spec (the questions object, see the decide skill) or specPath (a x.questions.json file). Returns the round id; then call wait. Images may be {"shot": url, "viewport": "mobile"} to capture a running page.

project.description: Absolute path of the project you are working in. Always pass it (Codex needs it).

spec.description: Questions spec: {title, intro?, questions: [{id, title, type?, options: [{id, label, recommended?}]}]}

specPath.description: Path to a spec file instead of spec; answers are written next to it.

open.description: Open or focus the browser page (default true).

tools.name: swipe
tools.description: Start a swipe interview: a deck of cards, each a simple question with exactly two answers (left / right), answered with the arrow keys (or with the user's own typed answer when neither fits), with the brief growing beside the deck. Pass spec {title, goal, cards: [{id, title, left: {label}, right: {label}, recommended?: "left"|"right"}], brief?, confidence?, batch?} or specPath. Then call wait: it returns batches of answers; answer each with push. At the end the user may add a note, or press "Dig deeper": wait then returns that event and you push a stricter round of cards.

project.description: Absolute path of the project you are working in. Always pass it (Codex needs it).

spec.description: The deck: {title, goal, cards: [{id, title, tldr?, body?, left, right, recommended?, reason?, from?, images?, compare?, video?, diff?, table?, chart?, mermaid?, preview?, code?}], brief?, confidence?, batch?}. Each side may carry the same media.

specPath.description: Path to a deck file instead of spec; answers and the brief are written next to it.

open.description: Open or focus the browser page (default true).

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait for the user on a round. Returns the answers digest, or a question the user asked you (answer it with explain, then wait again), or "still waiting" after timeoutSec: then call wait again at once. Don't end your turn while the round is open, or the answers never reach you.

project.description: Absolute path of the project you are working in. Always pass it (Codex needs it).

timeoutSec.description: How long to block, default 600, max 840.

tools.name: push
tools.description: Update an open swipe round after a batch: rewrite the brief, set your confidence, add follow-up cards, replace or remove cards the user hasn't answered. done: true tells the user you have no more questions. The user keeps answering while you push.

project.description: Absolute path of the project you are working in. Always pass it (Codex needs it).

add.description: New cards, same shape as in swipe.

position.description: Where new cards go: next (right behind the card on the user's screen) or end (default).

replace.description: Open cards to rewrite, matched by id.

remove.description: Ids of open cards that became moot.

brief.description: The whole brief, rewritten: short points, each a decision, risk, problem, open question or note. Replaces the previous brief.

goal.description: One line on what the interview is about, if it changed.

confidence.description: How well you now understand what the user wants, 0–100.

batch.description: Answers per batch from now on.

done.description: No important question left: the page shows the brief and asks the user to finish.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Answer the user's question about one question of an open round. The text (markdown) and visuals appear right under that question on the page.

project.description: Absolute path of the project you are working in. Always pass it (Codex needs it).

question.description: Question id the explanation belongs to.

askId.description: Id of the user's ask, if wait returned one.

text.description: Short, plain explanation. Markdown: lists, tables, > quotes, ### headings.

images.description: Image paths (absolute or relative to project) or URLs.

compare.description: Before/after slider: {before: image, after: image, labels?: [before, after]}.

video.description: A short clip: path or URL of an mp4, webm or gif, or {src, caption}.

diff.description: Side-by-side text diff: {before: text, after: text, lang?, labels?}.

chart.description: Simple chart: {type: "bar"|"line", labels: [...], series: [{name, values}], unit?, title?}.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a running web page with the local headless Chrome, or the screen of a booted iOS simulator / running Android emulator. Returns PNG paths (and the images) to use in a spec.

project.description: Absolute path of the project you are working in. Always pass it (Codex needs it).

simulator.description: Instead of url: capture the booted iOS simulator (xcrun simctl) or the Android emulator (adb).

device.description: With simulator: a simulator UDID or name, or an adb serial. Default: the booted one.

waitMs.description: Let the page settle this long before capturing, default 1500.

show.description: Return the images to you as well (default true).

tools.name: history
tools.description: Decisions already made in this project (newest first), to avoid asking the same thing twice.

project.description: Absolute path of the project you are working in. Always pass it (Codex needs it).

status.description: live: only decisions that still hold. Default all.

topic.description: A question you are about to ask: lists the live decisions on the same topic.

tools.name: supersede
tools.description: Mark an earlier decision as no longer holding, when the user decided otherwise in a later round. history and later rounds then stop treating it as settled, and its ADR (if any) gets a Superseded status.

project.description: Absolute path of the project you are working in. Always pass it (Codex needs it).

round.description: The id of the round whose decision no longer holds (history shows ids).

by.description: The id of the round that replaced it, if any.

reason.description: One line on why, in the user's language.

tools.name: adr
tools.description: Write a finished round as an architecture decision record in the repo: docs/decisions/NNNN-slug.md with context, options, decision and consequences. Writing the same round again updates its file.

project.description: Absolute path of the project you are working in. Always pass it (Codex needs it).

round.description: The round id. Default: the latest decision.

consequences.description: Markdown: what this makes easier and harder. Pros and cons of the picked options are added on their own.

dir.description: Folder relative to the project. Default docs/decisions.

tools.name: export
tools.description: Save a question round as one self-contained .html file for someone who can't reach this machine: they open it from disk, answer, and Done saves an answers JSON with their name. Pass round to export an open round, or spec/specPath to export without opening a page. Then end your turn; when the files come back, call import.

project.description: Absolute path of the project you are working in. Always pass it (Codex needs it).

round.description: An open question round to export.

spec.description: Or the questions object, as for ask.

out.description: Where to write the .html. Default: next to the spec, *.decide.html.

tools.name: import
tools.description: Read answers files saved from an exported page. One file settles the round (answers file, journal) and returns the digest; several files return each person's answers and where they disagree, and settle nothing.

project.description: Absolute path of the project you are working in. Always pass it (Codex needs it).

round.description: Override the round id the files carry.

specPath.description: The questions file, if decide no longer knows which one the round came from.
